<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple product (model product@1): the main picture and up to four thumbnails as a list (named by the
  product), beside the name as the heading, the price, a description and one action. Axes: media (start: the
  pictures before the copy from md up, end: after it, top: above it, wide).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ProductPhoto } from "./product-simple.types";

  export type ProductSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    price: string;
    image?: string;
    imageAlt: string;
    actionLabel?: string;
    actionHref?: string;
    photos: ProductPhoto[];
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    media?: "start" | "end" | "top";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    description = "",
    price,
    image = "",
    imageAlt,
    actionLabel = "",
    actionHref = "",
    photos,
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "start",
    media = "start",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ProductSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const frame = $derived(
    (media as string) === "top" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-8"
    : "grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-12 md:grid-cols-2"
  );
  const gallery = $derived(((media as string) === "end") ? "" : "order-first");
  const ratio = $derived(((media as string) === "top") ? "21/9" : "4/3");
  const thumbs = $derived(
    (media as string) === "top" ? "grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-6"
    : "grid-cols-4"
  );
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="product-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Box class={frame}>
      <Stack gap="6" align={column}>
        <Title as={level} size="4xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        <Text size="2xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", cn("text-primary", textAlign))}>
          {price}
        </Text>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="base" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
        {#if (actionLabel && actionHref)}
          <LinkButton variant="default" size="lg" href={urlOf(actionHref)}>
            {actionLabel}
          </LinkButton>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" class={gallery}>
        <MediaFrame alt={imageAlt} src={image} ratio={ratio} />
        <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 w-full list-none p-0", cn("grid gap-4", thumbs))}>
          {#each photos as t (t.id)}
            <ListItem data-slot="thumb">
              <MediaFrame alt={title} src={t.image} ratio="1/1" />
            </ListItem>
          {/each}
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
